title: In accordance with the provisions of G.L. c. 25, §§ 17, 17A and 18 of the General Laws, the Department hereby makes a preliminary assessment on the intra-state revenues of various electric and telephone companies for the fiscal year 1998 estimate of their proportionate share of the assessment.
